Quick update on the 404 error you reported when adding an additional associate to a case. We reproduced the error on our side, and our engineering team has added the fix to our October development sprint.

In the meantime, the new case is still created when the error appears. Select Return to Home, open the new case from the workbench and continue adding the information there.

I will update this ticket as soon as the fix is ready for release.

Kind Regards,
Appriss Retail Support
